ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
DELETE FROM app.BazaContributii
WHERE Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bc
SET

    bc.CAS =

        ROUND
        (
            ISNULL(bc.BazaCAS,0)

            *

            (ISNULL(bc.ProcCAS,0) / 100)

        ,0),

    bc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bc.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaContributii bc

WHERE bc.Luna = @Luna
  AND bc.Anul = @Anul
  AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bc
SET

    bc.VenitImpozabil =

        ISNULL(bc.BrutImpozabil,0)

        - ISNULL(bc.CAS,0)

        - ISNULL(bc.CASS,0),

    bc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bc.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaContributii bc

WHERE bc.Luna = @Luna
  AND bc.Anul = @Anul
  AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bc
SET

    bc.BazaImpozabila =

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0)

                - ISNULL(bc.DeducereTotala,0)
            ) < 0

            THEN 0

            ELSE
            (
                ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0)

                - ISNULL(bc.DeducereTotala,0)
            )
        END,

    bc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bc.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaContributii bc

WHERE bc.Luna = @Luna
  AND bc.Anul = @Anul
  AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bc
SET

    bc.Impozit =

        ROUND
        (
            ISNULL(bc.BazaImpozabila,0)

            *

            (ISNULL(bc.ProcImpozit,0) / 100)

        ,0),

    bc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bc.EsteProcesat = 1

FROM app.BazaContributii bc

WHERE bc.Luna = @Luna
  AND bc.Anul = @Anul
  AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

SET

    bc.ImpozitFinal =

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                ISNULL(bc.Impozit,0)

                - ISNULL(bc.ScutireImpozit,0)
            ) < 0

            THEN 0

            ELSE
            (
                ISNULL(bc.Impozit,0)

                - ISNULL(bc.ScutireImpozit,0)
            )
        END,

    bc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.BazaContributii bc

WHERE bc.Luna = @Luna
  AND bc.Anul = @Anul
  AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
